cases.name: Amanda "Mandi" Gordon
cases.narrative: IN 12/2019, her remains were found in a burn pit on the property of Samuel Roy Byrd's known business associates. Cadaver dogs searched the property where they had lived together, and alerted officers to a large shed in the backyard. Investigators found that blood had been present on the floor, the walls and on the entryway of the shed. Investigators also found blood in the residence in the bedroom and the bathroom.

cases.name: Jennifer Diaz
cases.about: She was co-owner of co-owner of Industry Print Shop in Austin, TX, Her estranged husband said Tony Diaz said he and Jennifer had been separated for about a year and she recently started seeing someone new. He was not aware of the new relationship until the night of the murder. He said his wife was the “purest soul [he] had ever come across.” “Her dream was always to help other people,” Diaz said. “She had a huge charitable heart. [She was a] very selfless and an amazing mother who loved her children.” The two were married for over 20 years, Diaz said, and started a business together 17 years ago. He said she wanted to grow the business so it could bring awareness to domestic violence, gun control, battered women, underprivileged children and the homeless. Her Go Fund Me said, "Jennifer Diaz was not only a beloved wife and mother but also a dedicated business owner and pillar of the Austin community. Through her work at Industry Print Shop, she contributed to the vibrant culture of the city and touched the lives of many. Her passion for her craft and her commitment to excellence were evident in everything she did. Beyond her professional endeavors, Jennifer was known for her kindness, generosity, and unwavering love for her family."
